blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines–The Philippine men’s U-23 football team absorbed a 2-0 loss to Vietnam on Friday in the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 at Minato Soccer Field. Two goals courtesy of Nguyen Thanh Nhan and Nguyen Le Phat crushed any hopes of the Philippines getting a famous result as it ended up losing a second straight match in Group C. It was a resolute defensive stand that kept the Philippines in a scoreless tie with the Vietnamese for the majority of the contest, with goalkeeper Nicholas Guimaraes producing several saves in both halves.
